why_synthetic.blocker: No verified pointwise experimental data matched the reconstructed solver condition. The source gives 290 K and 293 K cold-inlet values in different places, and does not provide complete independent structural truth and inputs.
why_synthetic.choice: Use a real publication for configuration context; explicitly assume only missing inputs needed for a runnable case; evaluate first-principles and numerical gates only.
why_synthetic.rejected_shortcut: Do not fabricate measurements or call solver outputs synthetic experimental truth.
why_synthetic.blindness: Not blind. HX-S01 is separate from and does not replace the stopped HX-B01 blind attempts.

operating_condition.temperature_note: 293 K follows a detailed boundary/loop description; another source passage states 290 K. This choice does not resolve the discrepancy.
